title: Manual position file (BOW front end, MANUAL POSITION FILE)
purpose: Each client's carried-forward derivatives positions at the previous business day's close, net: a long position as buy quantity and value, a short one as sell (value = quantity × average price, the premium for options). BOW takes either this file or the exchange position file, not both. BOW's sheet shows the sample in columns; the file is comma-separated like BOW's other uploads. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: BSE Member ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The firm's BSE member code (Settings)

columns.name: Exchange Market Segment
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 12 BSE F&O, 22 NSE F&O, 14 BSE currency, 24 NSE currency, 13 BSE commodity, 23 NSE commodity, 53 MCX, 33 NCDEX

columns.name: Product Type
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 margin / intraday, 2 CNC / delivery (BOW's default). Connections → BOW upload files (default 2)

columns.name: ClientID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: DealerId
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. For a dealer-wise position; blank is the client (as BOW's samples)

columns.name: Instrument Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE IF, SF, IO, SO; NSE FUTIDX, FUTSTK, OPTIDX, OPTSTK; FUTCUR, OPTCUR; FUTCOM, OPTFUT

columns.name: Symbol
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The exchange's symbol (BSE's own for BSE)

columns.name: Expiry Date
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Expiry date (BOW's sheet holds a date cell shown d-mmm-yy); written DD-MON-YYYY

columns.name: Option Type
columns.note: CE or PE; blank for futures

columns.name: Buy Qty
columns.note: Net buy quantity of a long position (lots for BSE, NSE and MCX commodities)

columns.name: Buy Value
columns.note: Net buy value (premium for options): quantity × average price

columns.name: Sell Qty
columns.note: Net sell quantity of a short position

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (manual position)
source: BOW File_Formats.xlsx, sheet MANUAL POSITION FILE
